translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: 2 Timoteo
book.title: Kart wchopi daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao Timotewa'

content: Na' li', ṉaa, xiiṉdawaa, gok wal daa chaklen Cristo Jesúza' li'.
Daa ba benilo' bli' bsedid' beṉ', bzajniin beṉ'ka' nx̱enlalloo, beṉ'ka' ṉezteilo' wak wli' wsedgakile'n beṉ' yoblə kon ka nakan.
Wzoac̱hec̱h btiḻ yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' chllaglo' ḻega beṉ' chon xshin Cristo Jesúza', ka chon' nad'.
Ni to beṉ' zeje' lo wdiḻa' aga dii yoblə zeze' wṉeyi, san chiyaḻ' kwej yic̱hje' yog'ḻoḻte kwenc̱he gone' daa yiyoolallii beena' wleje' ḻe' gake' soldad.
Ḻekzka' beena' chxoṉj, bibi gone' gan shi bi chzoe' dill' gone' yog'ḻoḻte daa llia bia' gone'.
Na' beena' cheeni yizi' yilape' chiyaḻ' wwa'gaxje' llin c̱heyin.
Wze wṉeyi dga nia' li', na' X̱anchona' wzajni'chile'n li' kwasḻoḻ.
Jadini Jesucrístona', beena' biban ladj beṉ' wetka', beena' nak xiiṉ dia c̱he dii Davina', kon ka na dill' wen dill' kob c̱he'na' daa chli' chsedid'.
Na' ni c̱heyinnan' chzak'zi'a, ax̱t ba wdix̱jgake' nad' lillyani ka to beṉ' wen dii mal. Per aga len cho'a xtilleenan' nej lillyani, san zejchlə chlliljan.

Daan chzo chzakid' yog' yeḻ' zak'zi' dii chak c̱ha', kwenc̱he beṉ'ka' ba wlej Chioza' gakgake' lall' nee gonḻilall'gake' Jesucrístona' na' yilagake' kwenc̱he bi kwiayi'gake', na' lljazoalengake'ne' zejḻi kaṉi.

content.text: Shi ba witlencho Crístona', ḻekzka' wbanlenchone'.
Na' shi so sakicho lao bittezə yeḻ' zi' yen ile'icho daa nakchone' txen, ḻekzka' iṉabia'lenchone'.
Shi cho' bi wc̱hebcho nakchone' txen, ka'kzə ḻe' iṉe' bi nake' cho' txen.
Ḻa'kzi cho' bi choncho daa chc̱hebcho, ḻe' chone' ka ba bc̱hebe',
ḻa' toshiizi chone' kon ka chc̱hebe' gone'.

content: Bi guetlalloo yisoo dga lall' beṉ'ka' chli' chsedilo'. Na' kon yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he Chioza' daa ba beṉe' li' bsi'ngakile' bi chiyaḻ' gakguedlenzə ljwellgake' ni c̱heyi diika' bibi zakii. Ḻa' bi chaklenan beṉ', san chlliayi'lan beṉ'ka' chzenagan.
Ben to dii byen gono' ka chazlall' Chioza' kwenc̱he bibi wsi'n li' yeḻ' zto' lo xshine'na', na' bli' bsedi dill' ḻi c̱he'na' kon ka nakan.
Bi wzenago' dill'ka' bi yejni'alallii na' bite bi zakgakan, ḻa' beṉ'ka' choe' dill' ka diika' zizikli chongake' daa bi choolall' Chioza'.
Ḻa' daa chli' chsedgakile' nakan ka to yillwe' dii nak lech na' chlliayi'n beṉ'. Ka' ben Himenewa' len Filétona',
biḻaala'ogake' dill' ḻi c̱he Chioza' na' nazgake' ba bisbanle' beṉ' wetka'. Na' chonllejgakile' beṉ'ka' ba nonḻilall'gake' Crístona'.

San dill' ḻi c̱he Chioza' nakan ka to len yoo dii zoac̱hec̱h. Na' dill' ḻi c̱he'na' nan ki: “X̱anchona' nombi'e beṉ'ka' nak lall' nee.” Na' ḻekzka' nan: “Nottezə beena' na nake' Crístona' txen, chiyaḻ' yikwase' lawi dii mala'.”
To ḻoo yoo lill beṉ' wni'a aga chc̱hine' shgaḻ' dii nak de or wa de plat, san nc̱hix̱gakan de yag len de yo. Baḻan naki gana' chc̱hine'n, na' baḻan chonan llin gattez.
Ka'kzan beena' chon daa chazlall' Chioza', saklebile' diika' nak de or wa de plat, na' zakee wc̱hin Chioza'ne' gone' dii zan dii wen.

Bi gono' txen ni to dii malka' cheeni beli chenna' kat' zoan lo yeḻ' wewaa. Na' ben to dii byen gako' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao', na' gonḻilalloo Crístona', na' gakilo' beṉ', na' soaleno' bish' ljwello'ka' mbalaz, ka chon yog' beṉ'ka' nxi nyech yic̱hjlalldoe'ka', beṉ'ka' choe'ḻwillgake' X̱anchona'.
Bi wzenago' dill'ka' biz chon chna, dill'ka' bibi zak', ḻa' ba ṉezkzilo' chx̱egakan wdiḻ.
To beṉ' nḻane' chone' xshin X̱anchona' bi chiyaḻ' wshagdiḻe' beṉ', san chiyaḻ' gonile' yog'ḻoḻ beṉ' wen. Na' chonan byen gak wli' wsedile' beṉ', na' chiyaḻ' gape' yeḻ' chxenlall'.
Na' chiyaḻ' we'lene' dill' xochi beṉ'ka' chzoshyi' daa nak dill' ḻi daa chli' chsedile', na' gone' lez shicholə Chioza' gaklene' ḻegake' kwenc̱he yiyaj yilengakile' na' gombia'gake' daa nak dii ḻi,
na' yiyeeṉ yiyeeṉigakile' na' yilagake' lo ṉi'a na' dii x̱iwaa daa ntakw nc̱hejan ḻegake' daa chongake' ka cheenin.
